phase: env: SMTP_URL smtp://mailpit:1025 and SMTP_FROM DOC-030 Environment <env-relay@helix.example> (overlay-mail-env.json); stored relay saved

steps.action: Deployment sets SMTP_URL and SMTP_FROM: the wizard step names the environment source and sender, with no relay form and no Send test email
steps.expected: Environment message; no Save relay, Replace relay, Clear relay or Send test email; a save is refused
steps.actual: The Outbound email step read "Outbound email is set by the deployment environment. Mail is sent from DOC-030 Environment <env-relay@helix.example>.". Its buttons were ["Back","Continue"]. A direct save answered 409 ("SMTP is set by the deployment environment (SMTP_URL / SMTP_FROM), which always wins over settings saved here. Change it in the environment instead.").

steps.action: Settings, Advanced, Outbound email with an environment relay: Managed by your deployment configuration; only Send test email; the test arrives from the environment sender, not the stored relay
steps.expected: Managed message; Sender line; one button; test mail from env-relay@helix.example
steps.actual: The pane at /settings/email read "Managed by your deployment configuration. Contact your system administrator to change the relay." and "Sender: DOC-030 Environment <env-relay@helix.example>". Pane buttons: ["Send test email"]. Send test email showed "Test email sent to doc030-wiz-admin@helix.example. Check your inbox." and the message arrived from DOC-030 Environment <env-relay@helix.example> although the stored relay (stored-relay@helix.example) was still saved.

steps.action: Invite your team from the wizard while the environment relay is active: the invitation arrives from the environment sender
steps.actual: The Invite your team step sent "Set your OpenLaw password" to doc030-wiz-pending@helix.example from env-relay@helix.example. The row stays pending for the resend check.

steps.action: Finish the wizard with email configured; it does not reopen
steps.expected: Skip optional steps completes setup; /welcome redirects
steps.actual: Skip optional steps on the Welcome step, with email configured, completed setup and went to /. Opening /welcome again went to /.
